name: Eclipsing Arrows marks allies healed by Hand of Elune (#7524)
contract: #7524: healing with Hand of Elune never applies the Eclipsing Arrows mark (574154). Engine path: AscensionStarcallerAbilities OnSpellHitResult casts 574154 on the healed target when the spell is Hand of Elune (801990) or Touch of Moonlight (574328) and the caster holds the talent aura, either current rank 800504 or legacy sibling 803554 (same passive shape, no acquisition rows, never referenced in code before this fix). Both legs pin their path with direct learns: a damaged ally healed by 801990 must carry aura 574154 from the caster. Talent acquisition itself is covered in game.

steps.label: Let spawn AI, level scaling and the login patch stream settle
SETUP: the talent aura is present
Wound the ally so the heal lands for nonzero
Heal the ally with Hand of Elune
SETUP: Hand of Elune cast accepted
DISCRIMINATING: the healed ally carries the Eclipsing Arrows mark
STREAM: the mark row reaches the client with its wording
Wound the ally again so the heal lands for nonzero
Heal the ally with Hand of Elune
DISCRIMINATING: the legacy rank marks too
